newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey sells 18.6 trln lira inflation-indexed bond.
newsitem.headline: Turkey sells 18.6 trln lira inflation-indexed bond.

text.p: The Turkish Treasury sold 18.6 trillion lira of nominal-value two-year bonds, indexed to consumer price inflation, at a risk premium of 25 percent.
This was Turkey's first issue of the new borrowing tool which was aimed at diversifying financial instruments and extending domestic debt maturity.
The total offer for the auction was 36.8 trillion lira, the central bank said.
The bonds will mature on March 5, 1999. Interest will be paid every three months, based on the year-on-year inflation at the date of payment.
The bonds have a value date of Wednesday when the Treasury has 36.17 trillion lira of debt repayments.
